risk.summary: VZ faces crisis-level volatility (VIX 417.6), flat yield curve recession signals, imminent CPI event (1 day), and earnings binary risk (11 days), creating a highly adverse macro backdrop for positioning.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross, Ichimoku cross, and three white soldiers form intermediate bullish structure with contrarian buy sentiment in fear zone, offering technical setup for swing trade entry.
